ports.name: Diablo (DevilutionX)
ports.summary: Set up Diablo through its upstream DevilutionX player using your own original files. Setup, profiles and updates stay upstream-owned.

presentation.manual_preparation: Use DIABDAT.MPQ from your own original PC Diablo CD or installation. The documented SPAWN.MPQ shareware provides limited shareware content only. Keep the packaged devilutionx.mpq; optional fonts and voice packs have separate upstream requirements. Keep your originals elsewhere unchanged; upstream handles its own data recognition and preparation. A Portcove registration does not authenticate original-game files. Extract the complete official Windows x86_64 ZIP and keep devilutionx.exe, devilutionx.mpq and all runtime companions together. A GOG installation may be detected; otherwise supply the matching MPQs beside the player or in the actual data directory described by upstream. Register devilutionx.exe inside its wrapper, using that same folder as working directory. Use the documented single argument --diablo to select this entry’s game even when both games’ files are present. The Windows data/profile location is normally %APPDATA%/diasurgical/devilution, with upstream portable/path overrides depending on the selected setup. Preserve the actual configuration, character saves and MPQ locations as well as the working copy, with all players closed before changing versions. Diablo and Hellfire modes have different original-data and save semantics. No automatic character conversion or cross-version save guarantee is supplied by registration. Finish upstream setup first. Registration saves your selected executable, working directory and literal arguments; Play is a separate explicit action. You and upstream own this external runtime, original files and profile. Registration-only removal preserves them. Managed Update, Backup, Rollback, migration and deletion are not offered for these external files. Preserve a working copy and its data before upstream replacement. Other platforms require their own supported upstream application/native flow.
